text:
fran: Quick design note  proposing sticky compact breadcrumbs that stay visible while scrolling long lists. Idea: show "Serving / <panel>" persistently with an affordance to expand org/ws context. Also adding a tiny "Copy permalink" action to the crumb so people can grab canonical path (includes slug + optional version). Thoughts?

evan: Love sticky crumbs for long pages. Two things: 1) permalink should copy canonical path (no query/hash), 2) we need to handle old bookmarks to /models and /deployments. Plan?

fran: Migration sketch: accept legacy /models & /deployments, client replaceState -> canonical /serving/:panel on first load, emit telemetry alias_mapped. Server-side we will 301 external requests. Keep aliases for 45 days and show a one-time migration banner.

sofia: Accessibility: sticky crumbs must not trap keyboard focus. Expand control for org/ws must be focusable (menu button pattern) and expose aria-expanded. When a permalink is copied, announce "Permalink copied" via polite aria-live.

lee: Router nit: if we canonicalize on load, use history.replaceState to avoid polluting back-stack. But if user navigates inside the app, pushState as usual. Also snapshot scroll before pushState for lists so back restores position.

evan: Permalink preview for Slack/Teams link unfurl: do we want Open Graph / meta tags to reflect the panel title? If so, server needs to render minimal metadata for these canonical paths. That means we should prefer path segments over hash fragments for shareability.

fran: Agreed on OG meta. We'll canonicalize to path segments for share actions and server-side previews. For hash-based arrivals we normalize to path after auth/cold-load. Doc-bot: note for docs?

doc-bot: Noted. Draft checklist: URL canonical list, alias behavior, migration banner copy, permalink UX, OG/meta requirements, keyboard matrix, telemetry keys. I'll open a docs PR.

a11y-bot: Extra nit: when crumb expands show full org/ws list in a menu and on open move focus to first menuitem. Escape should close and return focus to the crumb button. Truncated labels must include aria-label with full names.

sofia: Microcopy for the one-time banner: "We moved Models and Deployments into Serving. Your bookmarks will keep working for 45 days. Learn more." Make the "Learn more" link keyboard reachable. Use active voice.

evan: Dev checklist: middleware normalizer pseudocode ->

```
// on initial load
if (path matches /org/:o/ws/:w/models) {
  if (isExternalRequest) server301('/org/:o/ws/:w/serving/models')
  else history.replaceState(null, '', '/org/:o/ws/:w/serving/models')
  telemetry('alias_mapped')
}
```

fran: Telemetry we want: alias_mapped, permalink_copied, permalink_shared, sticky_crumb_expand, og_preview_requests. Also feature flag the sticky crumb for canary.

lee: UX motion: sticky crumb should fade in/out (120ms) and not cause layout shift. Use transform for the collapse/expand and render the expanded menu in a portal.

sofia: We'll run keyboard + screen reader pass on canary. Please post a canary link when ready.

fran: Thanks  I'll post mocks and the canonical URL spreadsheet here shortly and open a PR for the normalizer + crumb UI under a feature flag.
